propositions: CI wheel-probe must deterministically walk every rebar.* module and fail on any ImportError, reporting all failures without fail-fast

Script modules must be importable under their documented sys.path contract (scripts/ directory present) and importable failure in one script must not be masked by another script's sys.path manipulation

Optional-dependency modules (mcp, fastapi for extras like [mcp], [reviewbot]) must be attempted and reported as skipped only when their declared dependency is absent and ModuleNotFoundError.name matches the dependency
Historical regressions (bare subpackage imports without sys.path insert, as in alert_dedup/spinal-grayish-perch) must be caught and not masked by sibling scripts
Local portability: walk must be runnable from checkout with rebar installed, no CI dependency required
Script import-time side effects (t5c_calibrate.py with unguarded LLM calls) must be explicitly documented and skipped
